description:
List upcoming and ongoing Zindies events a creator (author/artist) is
involved in, identified by the creator's public token. A creator relates
to an event in two ways: as the host (events the creator itself hosts;
relation "organized") or as a participant (a reserved booth, being listed
as a participating creator, or hosting/speaking in one of the event's
programs such as a workshop or talk). Use `relation` to choose which to
include. Each event carries a `relations` array describing how this
creator relates to it. Note that the `organizer` field is a different
thing: it is the organizing body (a festival committee or group) that
hosts some events, not this creator. Same response shape as list_events
otherwise. Default range: today through 60 days ahead.

The response also carries `calendar`: a subscribable iCal feed of the
creator's upcoming events (`ics_url`, `webcal_url`, `google_calendar_url`
— same shape as list_events_by_place). Hand these to the user when they
want to follow a creator's events in their calendar app.

creator_token.description: Public token of the creator: a short lowercase string such as "fqpi", the `token` field of a creator from search, get_creator, get_creation or get_event. Not the numeric `id` or the name. An unknown or non-public token returns an error result with `error: "not_found"` (a creator with no matching events returns `events: []`, not an error).

event_type.description: `day` = single-day events (they have `started_at` / `ended_at`), `period` = multi-day exhibitions and fairs (`start_date` / `end_date`), `all` = both (default). Combined with the other filters by AND.

from.description: First day of the range, as an ISO 8601 calendar date in Japan time (YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-12-05"; no time or timezone part). Default: today. A multi-day event already under way on this day is included. A past date returns past events. An unparseable value falls back to the default.

kind.description: Return only events of this kind (non_genre = general ZINE event, zine_making = ZINE-making workshop, author = author event (talk, signing), festival_style = fair / market with many booths, zine_cafe = ZINE cafe, book_club = book club, utakai = tanka poetry gathering). Omit for every kind. Combined with `event_type` and the date range by AND.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return, soonest first. Default 20, max 50. There is no cursor: when `count` equals `limit` there may be more, so call again with `from` set to the start date of the last event returned.

locale.description: Response language for translatable text fields (names, titles, descriptions): ja = Japanese, en = English, ko = Korean, zh-TW = Traditional Chinese. Pass the language the user is conversing in when it is one of these; otherwise omit it. Fields without a translation fall back to their source language (usually Japanese), so one response can mix languages. Tokens, ids, dates and URLs are the same in every locale. Default: ja.

relation.description: Which events to include: `organized` = events the creator itself hosts, `participating` = events they join through a reserved booth, a listing as participating creator, or a program (workshop / talk), `all` = both (default). An event matching both ways is returned once, with both values in its `relations`. Use `participating` for "where can I meet this creator?".

to.description: Last day of the range, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-12-31"). Default: `from` + 60 days. For one specific day pass the same date as `from`. A value earlier than `from` returns no events.

name: list_events_by_creator
